## codegraph
# Codegraph — code intelligence over an indexed knowledge graph

Codegraph is a SQLite knowledge graph of every symbol, edge, and file
in the workspace. Reads are sub-millisecond; the index lags writes by
about a second through the file watcher. Consult it BEFORE writing or
editing code, not during.

## Answer directly — don't delegate exploration

For "how does X work", architecture, trace, or where-is-X questions,
answer DIRECTLY using 2-3 codegraph calls: `codegraph_context` first,
then ONE `codegraph_explore` for the source of the symbols it surfaces.
Codegraph IS the pre-built search index — so delegating the lookup to a
separate file-reading sub-task/agent, or running your own grep + read
loop, repeats work codegraph already did and costs more for the same
answer. Reach for raw Read/Grep only to confirm a specific detail
codegraph didn't cover. A direct codegraph answer is typically a handful
of calls; a grep/read exploration is dozens.

## Tool selection by intent

- **"What is the symbol named X?"** → `codegraph_search`
- **"What's the deal with this task / feature / area?"** → `codegraph_context` (PRIMARY — composes search + node + callers + callees in one call)
- **"How does X reach/become Y? / trace the flow / the path from X to Y"** → `codegraph_trace` (ONE call returns the whole call path, including dynamic-dispatch hops — callbacks, React re-render, JSX children — that grep can't follow)
- **"What calls this?"** → `codegraph_callers`
- **"What does this call?"** → `codegraph_callees`
- **"What would changing this break?"** → `codegraph_impact`
- **"Show me this symbol's source / signature / docstring."** → `codegraph_node`
- **"Show me several related symbols' source / survey an area."** → `codegraph_explore` (ONE capped call; prefer over many codegraph_node/Read)
- **"What's in directory X?"** → `codegraph_files`
- **"Is the index ready / what's its size?"** → `codegraph_status`

## Common chains

- **Flow / "how does X reach Y"**: `codegraph_trace` from→to FIRST — one call returns the entire path … [truncated]

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0
         https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.2.0</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.cc91</groupId>
    <artifactId>cc91-backend</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0</version>
    <name>CC91 Backend</name>
    <description>CC91 Forum System - Spring Boot Backend</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>17</java.version>
        <jjwt.version>0.12.3</jjwt.version>

        <mockito-inline.version>5.2.0</mockito-inline.version>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- Spring Boot Web -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Spring Boot Security -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-security</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Spring Boot Data JPA -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Spring Boot Validation -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Spring Boot Mail -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-mail</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- MySQL Driver -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.mysql</groupId>
            <artifactId>mysql-connector-j</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- H2 Database for Testing -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- JWT (io.jsonwebtoken) -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-api</artifactId>
            <version>${jjwt.version}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-impl</artifactId>
            <version>${jjwt.version}</version>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-jackson</artifactId>
            <version>${jjwt.version}</version>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-mysql</artifactId>

        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>me.paulschwarz</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-dotenv</artifactId>
            <version>4.0.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Spring Boot Test -->

            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Spring Security Test -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.security</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-security-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Mockito Inline for Java 17+ support -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.mockito</groupId>
            <artifactId>mockito-inline</artifactId>
            <version>${mockito-inline.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>

# 头像上传功能实现计划

## Context

用户资料页面 (`ProfileEditPage`) 当前仅支持通过输入 URL 文本设置头像。需要新增文件上传功能，支持 jpg/png/webp 格式，限制 2MB，使用本地文件存储。

## 变更概览

### 后端 (4 files: 2 new + 2 modify)

| 文件 | 操作 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `service/StorageService.java` | 新建 | 文件存储服务：校验类型/大小、存文件、删旧文件 |
| `controller/FileUploadController.java` | 新建 | `POST /api/upload/avatar` 端点 |
| `service/UserService.java` | 修改 | 新增 `uploadAvatar()` 方法，注入 StorageService |
| `config/WebConfig.java` | 修改 | 添加 `/uploads/avatars/**` 静态资源映射 |
| `config/SecurityConfig.java` | 修改 | 放行 `GET /uploads/avatars/**` |
| `config/GlobalExceptionHandler.java` | 修改 | 添加 `MaxUploadSizeExceededException` 处理 |
| `application.yml` | 修改 | 添加 upload 配置 + multipart 限制 |
| `.gitignore` | 修改 | 添加 `uploads/` |

### 前端 (4 files modify)

| 文件 | 操作 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `api/client.ts` | 修改 | FormData 时自动设置 multipart Content-Type |
| `api/user.ts` | 修改 | 新增 `uploadAvatar()` API 函数 |
| `vite.config.ts` | 修改 | 添加 `/uploads` 代理 |
| `pages/ProfileEditPage.tsx` | 修改 | URL 输入替换为文件选择 + 预览 + 上传 |

## 实现细节

### Step 1: 后端配置

**application.yml** — 添加:
```yaml
spring:
  servlet:
    multipart:
      max-file-size: 2MB
      max-request-size: 2MB

app:
  upload:
    avatar-dir: ${AVATAR_DIR:uploads/avatars}
```

**.gitignore** — 添加 `uploads/`

### Step 2: StorageService (新建)

- `@PostConstruct init()`: 创建上传目录
- `store(MultipartFile, Long userId)`: 校验 MIME 类型 (jpeg/png/webp) + 大小 (2MB)，生成文件名 `{userId}_{timestamp}.{ext}`，返回 URL `/uploads/avatars/{filename}`
- `delete(String fileUrl)`: 根据 URL 路径删除旧文件

安全措施：校验扩展名白名单 (jpg/jpeg/png/webp)，不使用原始文件名，防路径遍历。

### Step 3: UserService 修改

- 构造器注入 `StorageService`
- 新增 `uploadAvatar(String username, MultipartFile file)`:
  1. 查找用户和 Profile
  2. 如果旧 avatarUrl 以 `/uploads/avatars/` 开头，删除旧文件
  3. 调用 `storageService.store()` 获取新 URL
  4. 更新 Profile 并返回 DTO

### Step 4: FileUploadController (新建)

- `POST /api/upload/avatar` 接收 `@RequestParam("file") MultipartFile`
- 通过 `SecurityContextHolder` 获取当前用户名
- 调用 `userService.uploadAvatar()`
- 返回 `ApiResponse<Map<String, String>>` 包含 `avatarUrl`

### Step 5: WebConfig 修改

添加 `addResourceHandlers()`，映射 `/uploads/avatars/**` 到 `file:${avatarDir}/`

### Step 6: SecurityConfig 修改

在 `authorizeHttpRequests` 中添加 `.requestMatchers("GET", "/uploads/avatars/**").permitAll()`

### Step 7: GlobalExceptionHandler 修改

添加 `MaxUploadSizeExceededException` 处理，返回 400 + 中文提示

### Step 8: 前端 client.ts 修改

在请求拦截器中，检测 `config.data instanceof FormData` 时删除 `Content-Type`，让浏览器自动设置 multipart boundary。

### Step 9: 前端 api/user.ts 修改

新增 `uploadAvatar(file: File)` 函数，使用 FormData 发送 POST 到 `/upload/avatar`

### Step 10: 前端 vite.config.ts 修改

添加 `/uploads` 代理到 `http://localhost:8080`

### Step 11: 前端 ProfileEditPage.tsx 重写头像部分

- 移除 URL 文本输入
- 添加隐藏的 `<input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp">`
- 圆形预览区（显示当前头像或新选择的文件预览）
- 前端校验：类型 + 大小 2MB
- 提交流程：如有新文件 → 调 `uploadAvatar()` 获取 URL → 再调 `updateProfile()` 保存其他字段

## 验证方式

1. 后端编译通过: `cd backend && mvn compile`
2. 前端编译通过: `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit`
3. 前端测试通过: `cd frontend && npx vitest run`
4. 手动测试：启动前后端 → 登录 → 编辑资料 → 选择图片 → 预览 → 提交 → 查看资料页头像更新

content.text:
`high effort → 3+4 angles × 6 candidates → 1-vote verify (recall-biased) → ≤10 findings`

You are reviewing for **recall** at high effort: catch every real bug a careful
reviewer would catch in one sitting. At this level, catching real bugs matters
more than avoiding false positives. Err on the side of surfacing.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.

## Phase 1 — Find candidates (3 correctness angles + 3 cleanup angles + 1 altitude angle, up to 6 each)

Run **7 independent finder angles** via the Agent tool. Each
surfaces **up to 6 candidate findings** with `file`, `line`, a one-line
`summary`, and a concrete `failure_scenario`.

### Angle A — line-by-line diff scan

Read every hunk in the diff, line by line. Then Read the enclosing function for
each hunk — bugs in unchanged lines of a touched function are in scope (the PR
re-exposes or fails to fix them). For every line ask: what input, state, timing,
or platform makes this line wrong? Look for inverted/wrong conditions,
off-by-one, null/undefined deref, missing `await`, falsy-zero checks,
wrong-variable copy-paste, error swallowed in catch, unescaped regex metachars.

### Angle B — removed-behavior auditor

For every line the diff DELETES or replaces, name the invariant or behavior it
enforced, then search the new code for where that invariant is re-established.
If you can't find it, that's a candidate: a removed guard, a dropped error
path, a narrowed validation, a deleted test that was covering a real case.

### Angle C — cross-file tracer

For each function the diff changes, find its callers (Grep for the symbol) and
check whether the change breaks any call site: a new precondition, a changed
return shape, a new exception, a timing/ordering dependency. Also check callees:
does a parallel change in the same PR make a call unsafe?

### Reuse

The angles above hunt for bugs; this one and the next two hunt for cleanup in
the changed code. Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Name the cheaper alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change is implemented at the right depth, not as a fragile
bandaid. Special cases layered on shared infrastructure are a sign the fix
isn't deep enough — prefer generalizing the underlying mechanism over adding
special cases.

Cleanup and altitude candidates use the same `file`/`line`/`summary` shape; in
`failure_scenario`, state the concrete cost (what is duplicated, wasted, or
harder to maintain) instead of a crash. Correctness bugs always outrank
cleanup and altitude findings when the output cap forces a cut.

Pass every candidate with a nameable failure scenario through — finders that
silently drop half-believed candidates bypass the verify step and are the
dominant cause of misses.

## Phase 2 — Verify (1-vote, recall-biased)

Dedup near-duplicates (same defect, same location, same reason → keep one). For
each remaining candidate, run **one verifier** via the Agent tool:
give it the diff, the relevant file(s), and the candidate; it returns exactly
one of **CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED**.

**PLAUSIBLE by default** — do not refute a candidate for being "speculative" or
"depends on runtime state" when the state is realistic: concurrency races,
nil/undefined on a rare-but-reachable path (error handler, cold cache, missing
optional field), falsy-zero treated as missing, off-by-one on a boundary the
code does not exclude, retry storms / partial failures, regex/allowlist that
lost an anchor. These are PLAUSIBLE.

**REFUTED** only when constructible from the code: factually wrong (quote the
actual line); provably impossible (type/constant/invariant — show it); already
handled in this diff (cite the guard); or pure style with no observable effect.

Keep **CONFIRMED and PLAUSIBLE**. Drop REFUTED.

## Output

Return findings as a JSON array of at most 10 objects:

```json
[
  {
    "file": "path/to/file.ext",
    "line": 123,
    "summary": "one-sentence statement of the bug",
    "failure_scenario": "concrete inputs/state → wrong output/crash"
  }
]
```

Ranked most-severe first. If more than 10 survive, keep the 10 most
severe. If nothing survives verification, return `[]`.

Mock 模式下头像上传必挂** `mockDb.ts:923` `mockRequestAdapter` 里没有 `POST /upload/avatar` 的路由处理。当后端不可用、前端自动切到 mock 模式时，头像上传会返回 404 "Mock endpoint not found"，整个保存流程直接失败。 --- **4. 用户无法删除现有头像** `ProfileEditPage.tsx:42` 现在只有"选择新图片"按钮，没有"移除头像"按钮。`finalAvatarUrl || undefined` 这个逻辑意味着空字符串会被当作 undefined 跳过，后端 `updateProfile` 只更新非 null 字段，所以旧头像永远不会被清除。用户只能替换，不能删除。 --- ### P1 — 资源泄漏 / 用户体验回归 **5. ObjectURL 未在组件卸载时释放** `ProfileEditPage.tsx:84` 选择文件时调用 `URL.createObjectURL` 创建了 blob URL，在手动点击"取消选择"或"取消"时会释放。但如果用户直接点浏览器后退或点链接离开页面，组件卸载时没有任何 `useEffect` 清理函数来释放 blob URL，造成浏览器内存泄漏。 --- **6. 预览图片加载失败不再有错误提示** `ProfileEditPage.tsx:163` 旧代码的 `` 有 `onError` 处理器，会显示"预览图片加载失败，请检查 URL 是否有效"。新代码去掉了这个处理器。如果服务器存储的头像 URL 已失效，用户只看到浏览器原生的破图图标，没有任何文字说明。 --- ### P2 — 部署 / 健壮性 **7. 上传目录使用相对路径，部署到 JAR 时会出问题** `WebConfig.java:17` + `StorageService.java:34` `uploads/avatars` 是相对路径，解析依赖于 JVM 的工作目录。开发时从项目根目录启动没问题，但部署为 systemd 服务或 JAR 包时工作目录可能是 `/` 或用户主目录，导致文件存储和读取指向不同的位置，所有头像链接 404。 --- **8. 启动时创建目录失败被静默吞掉** `StorageService.java:36` `@PostConstruct init()` 中 `Files.createDirectories` 抛异常只打了 WARN 日志就跳过了。应用正常启动后，用户上传头像时 `Files.copy` 才会失败，报一个含义模糊的"文件存储失败"，管理员完全无法定位根因。 --- **9. 拦截器无条件覆盖 Content-Type** `client.ts:29` 请求拦截器对所有非 FormData 请求强制设置 `Content-Type: application/json`，会覆盖调用方传入的自定义值。目前没有受影响的调用，但未来如果需要发 `text/plain` 等其他类型的请求，会被静默覆盖为 JSON。 --- ### 建议优先修复 | 优先级 | 编号 | 修复方式 | |--------|------|----------| | 立即修 | #1 | 先存新文件、写数据库，成功后再删旧文件 | | 立即修 | #2 | `onSuccess` 中同时刷新 `users.detail(username)` 缓存 | | 尽快修 | #3 | mockDb 里加一条 `POST /upload/avatar` 路由 | | 尽快修 | #4 | 添加"移除头像"按钮，后端支持空字符串清除 | | 建议修 | #5 | 添加 `useEffect` 在卸载时 `revokeObjectURL` | | 建议修 | #6 | 给预览 `` 加回 `onError` 处理 | | 建议修 | #7 | 启动时将相对路径转为绝对路径 `Path.of(avatarDir).toAbsolutePath()` |

### #3 Mock 模式下头像上传必挂

项目的前端有一个 **mock 机制**：当后端服务不可用时（比如本地没启动 Spring Boot），axios 拦截器会自动把所有 API 请求转给 `mockDb.ts` 里的模拟适配器，用内存中的假数据响应，让前端可以独立开发/测试。

`mockDb.ts` 里有一个很长的 `if/else if` 链来匹配各种路由：

```
if url === '/auth/login' → 返回模拟登录结果
else if url === '/users/me' → 返回模拟用户资料
else if url === '/posts' → 返回模拟帖子列表
...
else → 返回 404 "Mock endpoint not found: POST /upload/avatar"
```

问题是：我们新增了 `POST /upload/avatar` 这个接口，但忘记在 mockDb 里加对应的路由。所以当后端不在线、前端处于 mock 模式时：

1. 用户选了图片点保存
2. `uploadAvatar()` 发 POST 到 `/upload/avatar`
3. mock 适配器没有这条路由 → 返回 404
4. 整个保存流程报错，用户看到"更新失败，请重试"

---

### #4 用户无法删除现有头像

旧版页面有一个**文本输入框**，用户可以手动编辑头像 URL，包括把它清空来"删除"头像。

新版把文本框换成了**文件选择按钮**，用户只能：
- 选一张新图片 → 替换头像
- 不选任何东西 → 保持原样

没有"移除头像"的入口。问题出在这段逻辑：

```typescript
let finalAvatarUrl = currentAvatarUrl;  // 服务端返回的现有 URL
if (selectedFile) {
  finalAvatarUrl = await uploadAvatar(selectedFile);
}
// ↓ 关键：空字符串会变成 undefined
return updateProfile({
  avatarUrl: finalAvatarUrl || undefined,  // "" → undefined
  ...
});
```

后端 `updateProfile` 的逻辑是"字段不为 null 才更新"：

```java
if (request.getAvatarUrl() != null) {
  profile.setAvatarUrl(request.getAvatarUrl());
}
```

所以 `undefined`（字段缺失）= 不更新 = 旧头像原样保留。用户没有任何办法把头像设为空。

content.text:
现在 `application.yml` 里配置的是：

```yaml
avatar-dir: uploads/avatars
```

这是一个**相对路径**，意思是"相对于你启动程序时所在的目录"。

开发时你在项目根目录跑 `mvn spring-boot:run`，工作目录是 `D:\aToys\LargeScale`，文件就存到 `D:\aToys\LargeScale\uploads\avatars`。没问题。

但部署时，比如用 systemd 服务启动 Spring Boot JAR：

```
# 工作目录可能是 / 或者 /home/app
java -jar cc91-backend.jar
```

这时 `uploads/avatars` 解析成 `/uploads/avatars`，是一个完全不同的位置。如果之前在开发机上传的头像文件都在项目目录下，部署后全找不到，所有头像 404。

不过对于你这个项目来说，如果只跑在本地或者固定目录下，这个问题**不会实际发生**。等真正要部署的时候，把配置改成绝对路径就行：

```yaml
avatar-dir: /var/lib/cc91/avatars
```

或者启动时传环境变量 `AVATAR_DIR=/var/lib/cc91/avatars`。现在不用管。

The error is clear: `Access denied for user '${DB_USERNAME}'@'localhost'` — the environment variables `DB_USERNAME` and `DB_PASSWORD` are not set. The `.env` file is in `.gitignore`. This is not related to the avatar upload changes at all — it's a database connection configuration issue.

The user needs to set up their `.env` file with the correct MySQL credentials, or start MySQL and make sure the credentials match.

content.text:
这跟头像上传无关，是数据库连不上。错误关键行：

```
Access denied for user '${DB_USERNAME}'@'localhost'
```

`${DB_USERNAME}` 没有被替换成实际值，说明环境变量没设。你需要在 `backend/` 目录下创建 `.env` 文件（已被 `.gitignore` 忽略），填入你的 MySQL 账号密码：

```
DB_USERNAME=root
DB_PASSWORD=你的密码
```

然后确保 MySQL 正在运行且 `cc91_db` 数据库存在。

content.text:
头像数据需要从数据库一路传到页面上，改了三层：

### 后端：让帖子带上作者头像

之前 `PostResponse` 只有 `authorId` 和 `authorUsername`，没有头像。帖子查出来后根本不知道作者长什么样。

改了 `PostService` 的三个转换方法：查帖子时顺便通过 `UserProfileRepository` 批量查作者的头像 URL，塞进 `PostResponse` 的新字段 `authorAvatarUrl`。用批量查询避免 N+1 问题。

### 前端数据层：类型对齐

`api/post.ts` 的 `Post` 接口加了 `authorAvatarUrl`，这样 React Query 拿到的数据里就有头像了。

### 前端 UI 层：三个地方用到头像

1. **Header 右上角** — 之前硬编码 `catAvatar`（静态图片导入），现在改成 `user.avatarUrl || catAvatar`，有真实头像就用，没有就用默认猫猫。

2. **PostCard 帖子卡片** — 之前用 `hashCode(username)` 随机选猫/学生头像，现在优先用 `authorAvatarUrl`，没有才 fallback。

3. **PostDetailPage / CommentSection** — 这两个地方渲染 PostCard，把帖子/评论数据里的 `authorAvatarUrl` 传下去。

### 头像同步机制

上传头像后 `AuthContext` 里的用户对象还是旧的。所以在 `ProfileEditPage` 的 `onSuccess` 回调里调了 `updateUserAvatar(data.avatarUrl)`，这个方法同时更新 state 和 localStorage，确保右上角立即刷新。

The log shows that the avatar upload itself worked fine:

```
2026-05-29 23:04:23 - Avatar stored: 1_1780067063011.png for userId=1
2026-05-29 23:04:23 - Deleted old avatar: 1_1780066067892.png
2026-05-29 23:04:23 - 澶村儚涓婁紶鎴愬姛: admin
2026-05-29 23:04:23 - 鐢ㄦ埛璧勬枡鏇存柊鎴愬姛: admin
```

But then there's an error:

```
2026-05-29 23:04:23 - Unexpected error: No static resource 1_1780066067892.png.
org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.NoResourceFoundException: No static resource 1_1780066067892.png.
```

This is the old avatar file being requested. The browser had cached the old avatar URL (`/uploads/avatars/1_1780066067892.png`) and when the page refreshed, it tried to load it. But we just deleted it! So it gets a 404.

This is actually expected behavior - the browser was still trying to load the old avatar image. After the page refreshes with the new URL, this won't happen again.

But wait - looking at the fix we made earlier (#1), we moved the delete AFTER the save. Let me re-read the log:

```
Avatar stored: 1_1780067063011.png for userId=1
Deleted old avatar: 1_1780066067892.png
```

This is correct - store new first, then delete old. But the browser had the old URL cached in its page and tried to fetch it after it was deleted. This is a normal race condition - the page was still showing the old avatar URL when the file was deleted.

The real issue is that the `NoResourceFoundException` is logged as "Unexpected error" by the GlobalExceptionHandler. This is harmless but noisy. The browser just needs the new URL, which it gets after the profile query refreshes.

This is not actually a bug - it's just the browser's cached HTML/React state still referencing the old file. Once the page updates with the new avatar URL, it works fine.

I should explain this to the user - it's not an error that needs fixing. The old avatar was deleted (correctly), and the browser briefly tried to load it before getting the updated URL.

`high effort → 3+4 angles × 6 candidates → 1-vote verify (recall-biased) → ≤10 findings`

You are reviewing for **recall** at high effort: catch every real bug a careful
reviewer would catch in one sitting. At this level, catching real bugs matters
more than avoiding false positives. Err on the side of surfacing.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.

## Phase 1 — Find candidates (3 correctness angles + 3 cleanup angles + 1 altitude angle, up to 6 each)

Run **7 independent finder angles** via the Agent tool. Each
surfaces **up to 6 candidate findings** with `file`, `line`, a one-line
`summary`, and a concrete `failure_scenario`.

### Angle A — line-by-line diff scan

Read every hunk in the diff, line by line. Then Read the enclosing function for
each hunk — bugs in unchanged lines of a touched function are in scope (the PR
re-exposes or fails to fix them). For every line ask: what input, state, timing,
or platform makes this line wrong? Look for inverted/wrong conditions,
off-by-one, null/undefined deref, missing `await`, falsy-zero checks,
wrong-variable copy-paste, error swallowed in catch, unescaped regex metachars.

### Angle B — removed-behavior auditor

For every line the diff DELETES or replaces, name the invariant or behavior it
enforced, then search the new code for where that invariant is re-established.
If you can't find it, that's a candidate: a removed guard, a dropped error
path, a narrowed validation, a deleted test that was covering a real case.

### Angle C — cross-file tracer

For each function the diff changes, find its callers (Grep for the symbol) and
check whether the change breaks any call site: a new precondition, a changed
return shape, a new exception, a timing/ordering dependency. Also check callees:
does a parallel change in the same PR make a call unsafe?

### Reuse

The angles above hunt for bugs; this one and the next two hunt for cleanup in
the changed code. Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Name the cheaper alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change is implemented at the right depth, not as a fragile
bandaid. Special cases layered on shared infrastructure are a sign the fix
isn't deep enough — prefer generalizing the underlying mechanism over adding
special cases.

Cleanup and altitude candidates use the same `file`/`line`/`summary` shape; in
`failure_scenario`, state the concrete cost (what is duplicated, wasted, or
harder to maintain) instead of a crash. Correctness bugs always outrank
cleanup and altitude findings when the output cap forces a cut.

Pass every candidate with a nameable failure scenario through — finders that
silently drop half-believed candidates bypass the verify step and are the
dominant cause of misses.

## Phase 2 — Verify (1-vote, recall-biased)

Dedup near-duplicates (same defect, same location, same reason → keep one). For
each remaining candidate, run **one verifier** via the Agent tool:
give it the diff, the relevant file(s), and the candidate; it returns exactly
one of **CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED**.

**PLAUSIBLE by default** — do not refute a candidate for being "speculative" or
"depends on runtime state" when the state is realistic: concurrency races,
nil/undefined on a rare-but-reachable path (error handler, cold cache, missing
optional field), falsy-zero treated as missing, off-by-one on a boundary the
code does not exclude, retry storms / partial failures, regex/allowlist that
lost an anchor. These are PLAUSIBLE.

**REFUTED** only when constructible from the code: factually wrong (quote the
actual line); provably impossible (type/constant/invariant — show it); already
handled in this diff (cite the guard); or pure style with no observable effect.

Keep **CONFIRMED and PLAUSIBLE**. Drop REFUTED.

## Output

Return findings as a JSON array of at most 10 objects:

```json
[
  {
    "file": "path/to/file.ext",
    "line": 123,
    "summary": "one-sentence statement of the bug",
    "failure_scenario": "concrete inputs/state → wrong output/crash"
  }
]
```

Ranked most-severe first. If more than 10 survive, keep the 10 most
severe. If nothing survives verification, return `[]`.
